title: Observation field declarations (spec/feature/observation-boundary.md)
description: Game-specific places a player Observation frame may carry, each with its knowledge and where the player perceives it. Used by manifest observation.fields and the replay header observation_fields. Base fields (tick, self.pos, entities[].pos, extra.reach ...) are fixed by Commentarii and cannot be declared.

origin.description: Where the player perceives it (HUD gauge, damage number, ...).
